neighbours.label: an event that removes a person or thing and so causes a loss or vacancy (death, dies, resignation, theft), named as the cause, as against the same sentences where the post or stock changes for routine reasons
fire: The board must appoint a new treasurer if the current one dies.
The bishop's seat stayed empty for a year after the death of Bishop Moore.
A by-election followed the sudden resignation of the local MP.
Most of the missing stock was lost through theft by night staff.
Under the rules, if the king dies, his eldest daughter takes the throne.
The court post opened up after the resignation of Judge Harlan.
The museum's collection shrank because of theft during the war.
His brother inherited the farm after the death of their uncle.
quiet: The board must appoint a new treasurer every two years.
The bishop's seat was filled within a month by Bishop Moore.
A by-election followed the creation of a new district last spring.
Most of the missing stock was simply moved to the second warehouse.
Under the rules, the king's eldest daughter attends every council.
The court post was advertised in the national papers in June.
The museum's collection grew because of gifts after the war.
His brother bought the farm after a long talk with their uncle.
